design_decisions.title: Use external gate drivers and MOSFET H-bridges
design_decisions.rationale: The V0.1 board validates an industrial stepper-driver architecture without integrated driver ICs.
design_decisions.impact: The design exposes gate driver, MOSFET, shunt, and hardware protection blocks for review.

design_decisions.title: Use STM32G4-class MCU
design_decisions.rationale: STM32G4 devices provide motor-control timers, complementary PWM, ADC synchronization, DMA, break inputs, UART, and SWD.
design_decisions.impact: The schematic skeleton reserves PWM, ADC, fault, STEP/DIR/EN, UART, and SWD nets.

design_decisions.title: Gate resistors and bootstrap capacitors added
design_decisions.rationale: Each MOSFET gate must have a series resistor to control switching speed and prevent ringing. Bootstrap capacitors are required for high-side N-MOSFET drive.
design_decisions.impact: Added 8 gate resistors, 8 gate-source pulldown resistors, and 2 bootstrap capacitors with bootstrap diodes.

design_decisions.title: ADC RC filters added for all analog inputs
design_decisions.rationale: Current sense, bus voltage sense, and temperature sense signals require anti-aliasing filters before the MCU ADC inputs.
design_decisions.impact: Added RC low-pass filters for IA, IB, VBUS, and TEMP ADC channels.

design_decisions.title: USB-UART bridge included as optional debug interface
design_decisions.rationale: A USB-UART bridge (CH340C-class) provides convenient debug and configuration access without requiring an external USB-UART adapter.
design_decisions.impact: Added USB-C connector and CH340C-class bridge IC connections, sharing TX/RX with the UART debug header.

design_decisions.title: Keep LCSC locking pending
design_decisions.rationale: Availability, stock, package, and EasyEDA/KiCad library quality must be checked live before locking fabrication parts.
design_decisions.impact: The model uses pending placeholder parts and requires a later part.lock.yaml pass.

design_decisions.title: Use 4x IRS2104STR SOIC-8 half-bridge gate drivers
design_decisions.rationale: Each IRS2104STR drives one half-bridge (2 MOSFETs). Two half-bridges per phase form a full H-bridge. Matches hardware spec option A.
design_decisions.impact: Updated model from 2x16p full-bridge to 4x8p half-bridge drivers with individual bootstrap caps and PWM routing.

design_decisions.title: Add buck feedback resistors (30k/10k) for XL7015E1 5V output
design_decisions.rationale: XL7015E1 is adjustable output. R1=30k/R2=10k gives Vout=1.25*(1+3)=5.0V.
design_decisions.impact: R_BUCK_FB1, R_BUCK_FB2, C_BUCK_SS added to power section.

design_decisions.title: Fix fuse from 0.5A PTC to 5A SMD fuse (2410FA-5A)
design_decisions.rationale: Original C165760 is 0.5A hold current. 24V/3A system needs 5A fuse.

design_decisions.title: Add 0.5R ESR resistor for AMS1117-3.3 stability
design_decisions.rationale: AMS1117 needs ESR 0.1-10 ohm on output cap. MLCC ESR < 0.01 ohm causes oscillation.
design_decisions.impact: R_LDO_ESR=0.5R added in series with C_LDO_OUT.

design_decisions.title: Add 1500W SMC TVS for regenerative braking overvoltage protection
design_decisions.rationale: Motor deceleration pumps energy back to DC bus. SMCJ58A 1500W TVS provides clamping. Q_BRAKE+RG_BRAKE reserved for active braking.
design_decisions.impact: D_BUS_CLAMP across VM_BUS. Q_BRAKE, RG_BRAKE reserved unpopulated.

risks: This is a KiCad skeleton model, not a production-ready schematic.
Final LCSC part numbers are not locked; run resolver and datasheet review before fabrication.
Gate-driver and MOSFET pairing is high risk until drive current, bootstrap behavior, UVLO, Qg, and dead-time behavior are verified.
MOSFET thermal design and high-current terminal footprints require manual PCB review.
Hardware overcurrent threshold values and comparator delay are not finalized.
Bus regenerative energy handling is only reserved conceptually; braking dump control is not implemented in V0.1.
Gate resistors may need tuning based on actual MOSFET Qg and driver strength to optimize switching losses vs EMI.
Bootstrap capacitor values depend on gate driver switching frequency and MOSFET Qg; verify before fabrication.
